^A.name: Font Selection
^A.description: Select device font, orientation, and font size (dots).

^A@.name: Use Font Name to Call Font
^A@.description: Selects a font by its full filename rather than a single-character identifier. Once defined, the font name persists for subsequent ^A@ commands until a new name is specified.

^B0.name: Aztec Bar Code
^B0.description: Print an Aztec two-dimensional matrix barcode with configurable magnification, error correction, and structured append.

^B1.name: Code 11 Bar Code
^B1.description: Print a Code 11 (USD-8) barcode with options for check digit, height, and interpretation line.

^B2.name: Interleaved 2 of 5 Bar Code
^B2.description: Print an Interleaved 2 of 5 barcode, a high-density self-checking continuous numeric symbology.

^B3.name: Code 39 Bar Code
^B3.description: Print a Code 39 barcode with options for Mod-43 check digit, height, and interpretation line.

^B4.name: Code 49 Bar Code
^B4.description: Print a Code 49 multi-row barcode capable of encoding the full 128-character ASCII set.

^B5.name: Planet Code Bar Code
^B5.description: Print a Planet Code barcode used by USPS for mail tracking.

^B7.name: PDF417 Bar Code
^B7.description: Print a PDF417 two-dimensional stacked barcode capable of encoding over 1000 characters.

^B8.name: EAN-8 Bar Code
^B8.description: Print an EAN-8 barcode, the shortened version of EAN-13.

^B9.name: UPC-E Bar Code
^B9.description: Print a UPC-E barcode, a zero-suppressed variation of UPC-A.

^BA.name: Code 93 Bar Code
^BA.description: Print a Code 93 barcode, a variable-length continuous symbology using the full 128-character ASCII set.

^BB.name: CODABLOCK Bar Code
^BB.description: Print a CODABLOCK two-dimensional stacked barcode (modes A, E, F) for encoding large amounts of data.

^BC.name: Code 128 Bar Code
^BC.description: Print a Code 128 barcode with options for height, text, and checks.

^BD.name: UPS MaxiCode Bar Code
^BD.description: Print a UPS MaxiCode two-dimensional barcode symbol.

^BE.name: EAN-13 Bar Code
^BE.description: Print an EAN-13 barcode widely used in Europe and Japan for retail packaging.

^BF.name: MicroPDF417 Bar Code
^BF.description: Print a MicroPDF417 barcode, a compact variant of PDF417 for area-efficient applications.

^BI.name: Industrial 2 of 5 Bar Code
^BI.description: Print an Industrial 2 of 5 barcode, a discrete self-checking numeric symbology.

^BJ.name: Standard 2 of 5 Bar Code
^BJ.description: Print a Standard 2 of 5 barcode, a discrete self-checking numeric symbology.

^BK.name: ANSI Codabar Bar Code
^BK.description: Print an ANSI Codabar barcode used in libraries, medical, and shipping applications.

^BL.name: LOGMARS Bar Code
^BL.description: Print a LOGMARS barcode, a Department of Defense application of Code 39 with mandatory Mod 43 check digit.

^BM.name: MSI Bar Code
^BM.description: Print an MSI barcode, a pulse-width modulated continuous non-self-checking symbology.

^BO.name: Aztec Bar Code Parameters
^BO.description: Print an Aztec barcode (alternate command) with configurable magnification, error correction, and structured append.

^BP.name: Plessey Bar Code
^BP.description: Print a Plessey barcode, a pulse-width modulated continuous non-self-checking symbology.

^BQ.name: QR Code Bar Code
^BQ.description: Print a QR Code two-dimensional matrix barcode with configurable model, magnification, and error correction.

^BR.name: GS1 DataBar Bar Code
^BR.description: Print a GS1 DataBar (formerly Reduced Space Symbology) barcode for space-constrained identification.

^BS.name: UPC/EAN Extensions
^BS.description: Print a UPC/EAN two-digit or five-digit extension barcode used for ISBNs and periodicals.

^BT.name: TLC39 Bar Code
^BT.description: Print a TLC39 composite barcode combining Code 39 and MicroPDF417 for TCIF telecommunications tagging.

^BU.name: UPC-A Bar Code
^BU.description: Print a UPC-A barcode, a fixed-length numeric symbology for retail packaging.

^BX.name: Data Matrix Bar Code
^BX.description: Print a Data Matrix symbol (height, quality, rows/cols, format, and more).

^BY.name: Bar Code Field Default
^BY.description: Set defaults for subsequent barcode fields (module width, ratio, height).

^BZ.name: POSTAL Bar Code
^BZ.description: Print a POSTAL barcode (Postnet, Planet, or USPS Intelligent Mail) for automated mail handling.

^CC.name: Change Caret Command Prefix
^CC.description: Changes the format command prefix character from the default caret (^) to any other ASCII character. Takes immediate effect for all subsequent commands.

~CC.name: Change Caret Command Prefix
~CC.description: Changes the format command prefix character from the default caret (^) to any other ASCII character. Takes immediate effect for all subsequent commands.

^CD.name: Change Delimiter Character
^CD.description: Changes the parameter delimiter character from the default comma (,) to any other ASCII character. Affects all subsequent commands that use parameter separation.

~CD.name: Change Delimiter Character
~CD.description: Changes the parameter delimiter character from the default comma (,) to any other ASCII character. Affects all subsequent commands that use parameter separation.

^CF.name: Change Alphanumeric Default Font
^CF.description: Set default font name, height, and width for ^A commands.

^CI.name: Change International Font/Encoding
^CI.description: Select international character set (code page) and optionally remap individual characters.

^CM.name: Change Memory Letter Designation
^CM.description: Reassigns letter designations for the printer's memory devices (B:, E:, R:). Allows reformatting memory references without altering existing format files. Impacts all subsequent file operation commands.

^CN.name: Cut Now
^CN.description: Causes the printer to cycle the media cutter. Only effective in Kiosk print mode (^MMK). The command is ignored if parameters are missing or invalid.

^CO.name: Cache On
^CO.description: Controls the scalable character cache size and type. Increasing cache size improves scalable font performance but reduces memory available for label bitmaps, graphics, and fonts.

^CP.name: Remove Label
^CP.description: Causes the printer to move a printed label out of the presenter area by ejecting, retracting, or taking the action defined by ^KV.

^CT.name: Change Tilde Control Prefix
^CT.description: Changes the control command prefix character from the default tilde (~) to any other ASCII character. Takes immediate effect for all subsequent control commands.

~CT.name: Change Tilde Control Prefix
~CT.description: Changes the control command prefix character from the default tilde (~) to any other ASCII character. Takes immediate effect for all subsequent control commands.

^CV.name: Code Validation
^CV.description: Enable/disable code validation for bar code data integrity checking.

^CW.name: Font Identifier
^CW.description: Assigns a single alphanumeric character identifier to a downloaded font stored in printer memory. This allows the font to be referenced by ^A using the assigned letter.

^DF.name: Download Format
^DF.description: Saves ZPL II format commands as text strings to be later merged using ^XF with variable data. The format may contain ^FN commands for field referencing when recalled. Enter immediately after ^XA.

^FB.name: Field Block
^FB.description: Format block text: width, lines, line spacing, justification, indent.

^FC.name: Field Clock
^FC.description: Sets the clock indicators (delimiters) and the clock mode for use with the Real-Time Clock hardware within field data.

^FD.name: Field Data
^FD.description: Begin field data; content continues until ^FS. ^FD supplies fixed data, ^FV supplies variable data that can be overridden at print time.

^FV.name: Field Data
^FV.description: Begin field data; content continues until ^FS. ^FD supplies fixed data, ^FV supplies variable data that can be overridden at print time.

^FE.name: Field Concatenation
^FE.description: Allows field data concatenation and substring extraction by referencing ^FN fields. Use #n# to insert an entire ^FN field, or #n,a,x,y# to insert a substring.

^FH.name: Field Hexadecimal Indicator
^FH.description: Enable hexadecimal escape indicator for field data (default '_').

^FL.name: Font Linking
^FL.description: Links TrueType fonts together so that if the base font lacks a glyph, the printer looks to linked fonts for the character.

^FM.name: Multiple Field Origin Locations
^FM.description: Designates multiple field origin locations for PDF417 and MicroPDF417 bar codes when using structured append capabilities.

^FN.name: Field Number
^FN.description: Assigns a field number for use with stored formats (^DF/^XF). When a format is recalled with ^XF, the ^FN fields are populated with data from the recalling format's ^FN-matched ^FD fields.

^FO.name: Field Origin
^FO.description: Set field origin (x,y) in dots, relative to label home (^LH). Optional z parameter sets justification (0=left, 1=right, 2=auto).

^FP.name: Field Parameter
^FP.description: Sets the field direction and additional inter-character gap for text fields.

^FR.name: Field Reverse Print
^FR.description: Allows a field to appear as white over black or black over white. The color of the output is the reverse of its background. Applies to only one field and must be specified each time. For label-wide reverse, use ^LR.

^FS.name: Field Separator
^FS.description: Field separator: ends the current field and denotes the end of one complete field definition.

^FT.name: Field Typeset
^FT.description: Set field typeset origin (x,y) using baseline positioning. If x or y is omitted, the position after the last formatted text field is used. Optional z parameter sets justification (0=left, 1=right, 2=auto).

^FW.name: Field Orientation
^FW.description: Set default field orientation and justification for subsequent fields.

^FX.name: Comment
^FX.description: Non-printing comment. Any data after ^FX is treated as a comment and not processed until the next caret (^) or tilde (~) command prefix is encountered. Avoid using ^ or ~ within the comment text.

^GB.name: Graphic Box
^GB.description: Draw a graphic box/line with width, height, border thickness, color, and corner rounding (0=none to 8=heaviest).

^GC.name: Graphic Circle
^GC.description: Produces a circle on the printed label. Parameters specify diameter, border thickness (extends inward), and line color.

^GD.name: Graphic Diagonal Line
^GD.description: Produces a straight diagonal line on a label within a bounding box defined by width and height. Can be used with other graphic commands to create complex figures.

^GE.name: Graphic Ellipse
^GE.description: Produces an ellipse in the label format with specified width, height, border thickness, and color.

^GF.name: Graphic Field
^GF.description: Graphic field: download graphic data directly into bitmap storage. Parameters: compression type (A=ASCII hex, B=binary, C=compressed binary), binary byte count, graphic field count, bytes per row, followed by data.

^GS.name: Graphic Symbol
^GS.description: Enables generation of registered trademark, copyright symbol, and other symbols. Use with ^FD and character A-E to select the desired symbol.

^HF.name: Host Format
^HF.description: Sends stored formats back to the host computer via the communication port.

^HG.name: Host Graphic
^HG.description: Uploads graphic data from the printer to the host computer. The graphic image can be stored for future use or downloaded to any Zebra printer.

^HH.name: Configuration Label Return
^HH.description: Echoes printer configuration information back to the host using a terminal emulator.

^HL.name: Return RFID Data Log to Host
^HL.description: Returns the RFID data log stored in the printer's RAM to the host computer. The log contains RFID operation records including read/write operations, program positions, antenna elements, power levels, and status codes.

~HL.name: Return RFID Data Log to Host
~HL.description: Returns the RFID data log stored in the printer's RAM to the host computer. The log contains RFID operation records including read/write operations, program positions, antenna elements, power levels, and status codes.

^HR.name: Calibrate RFID Tag Position
^HR.description: Initiates RFID tag calibration to determine optimal programming position, antenna element, and read/write power levels for the RFID media being used.

^HT.name: Host Linked Fonts List
^HT.description: Returns the complete list of font links to the host over a communication port.

^HV.name: Host Verification
^HV.description: Returns data from specified fields, along with an optional ASCII header, to the host computer. Used with fields assigned a number via ^FN or ^RF commands.

^HW.name: Host Directory List
^HW.description: Transmits a directory listing of objects in a specific memory area back to the host device.

^HY.name: Upload Graphics
^HY.description: Uploads graphic objects from the printer to the host in any supported format (GRF or PNG).

^HZ.name: Display Description Information
^HZ.description: Returns printer description information in XML format including format parameters, object directories, individual object data, and print status information.

^ID.name: Object Delete
^ID.description: Deletes objects, graphics, fonts, and stored formats from storage areas. Objects can be deleted selectively or in groups using the asterisk (*) wildcard.

^IL.name: Image Load
^IL.description: Loads a stored image at the beginning of a label format and merges it with additional data. The image is always positioned at 0,0. Used with ^IS to overlay constant information with variable data for increased throughput.

^IM.name: Image Move
^IM.description: Performs a direct move of an image from storage area into the bitmap. Identical to ^XG but without magnification parameters. Can be positioned anywhere on the label using ^FO.

^IS.name: Image Save
^IS.description: Saves the current label format as a graphic image rather than a ZPL II script. The saved image can be recalled with ^IL with virtually no formatting time and overlaid with variable data.

^JB.name: Initialize Flash Memory
^JB.description: Initializes various types of Flash memory available in Zebra printers. Initializing memory can take several minutes.

^JH.name: Early Warning Settings
^JH.description: Configures early warning messages on the LCD for media, ribbon, maintenance, and head life. Save changes permanently with ^JUS.

^JI.name: Start ZBI (Zebra BASIC Interpreter)
^JI.description: Initializes the Zebra BASIC Interpreter (ZBI). Only one ZBI interpreter can be active at a time. Deactivate with ZPL at the ZBI prompt or ~JQ.

^JJ.name: Set Auxiliary Port
^JJ.description: Controls an online verifier or applicator device through the auxiliary port. Configures operational mode, application signals, error handling, and ribbon monitoring.

^JM.name: Set Dots per Millimeter
^JM.description: Lowers print density: 24→12, 12→6, 8→4, 6→3 dots/mm. Also affects field origin (^FO) placement. Must be entered before the first ^FS in a format.

^JS.name: Sensor Select
^JS.description: Specifies which sensor to use for media detection. Only for use with S4M and some Z Series printers; ignored on ZM400/ZM600 and RZ400/RZ600.

^JT.name: Head Test Interval
^JT.description: Changes the printhead test interval. Supports testing a range of print elements. The printer automatically selects the test range by tracking which elements have been used since the previous test.

^JU.name: Configuration Update
^JU.description: Sets the active configuration for the printer. Save current settings, recall saved settings, or reload factory defaults.

^JW.name: Set Ribbon Tension
^JW.description: Sets the ribbon tension for the printer. Used only for PAX series printers.

^JZ.name: Reprint After Error
^JZ.description: Controls whether a partially printed label caused by a Ribbon Out, Media Out, or Head Open error is reprinted when the error condition is corrected. Remains active until another ^JZ command is sent or the printer is turned off.

^KC.name: Set Client Identifier
^KC.description: Allows the print server to have its own client identifier (DHCP Option 61).

^KD.name: Select Date and Time Format
^KD.description: Selects the format for the Real-Time Clock date and time display on configuration labels and the control panel.

^KL.name: Define Language
^KL.description: Selects the language displayed on the printer control panel.

^KN.name: Define Printer Name
^KN.description: Sets the printer's network name and description, displayed on configuration labels and the printer's web page.

^KP.name: Define Password
^KP.description: Defines the password required to access the control panel switches and LCD Setup Mode.

^KV.name: Kiosk Values
^KV.description: Sets kiosk mode parameters including cut amount, cut margin, present type, present timeout, and presenter loop length.

^LF.name: List Font Links
^LF.description: Prints out a list of the linked fonts. Device query command with no parameters.

^LH.name: Label Home
^LH.description: Set label home (origin) offset in dots.

^LL.name: Label Length
^LL.description: Set printable label length (height) in dots. Format: ^LLy.x where x controls whether length applies to all media types.

^LR.name: Label Reverse Print
^LR.description: Reverse print (invert) the label when enabled.

^LS.name: Label Shift
^LS.description: Shifts all field positions to the left for compatibility with Z-130/Z-220 printer formats. Retained until power-off or new ^LS command.

^LT.name: Label Top
^LT.description: Moves the entire label format up or down relative to the top edge of the label for fine-tuning position without changing other parameters.

^MA.name: Set Maintenance Alerts
^MA.description: Controls how the printer issues printed maintenance alerts for printhead cleaning or replacement. Alerts print a warning label when distance thresholds are reached.

^MC.name: Map Clear
^MC.description: Controls whether the bitmap is cleared after the format has been printed. Use N to retain the current label image as background for the next label.

^MD.name: Media Darkness
^MD.description: Adjusts the media darkness relative to the current darkness setting. Range -30 to +30, clamped to the 0-30 absolute range.

^MF.name: Media Feed
^MF.description: Dictates what happens to the media at power-up and at head-close after error clears.

^MI.name: Set Maintenance Information Message
^MI.description: Controls the content of maintenance alert messages that remind the operator to clean or replace the printhead.

^ML.name: Maximum Label Length
^ML.description: Sets the maximum label length in dot rows. Required for proper calibration of non-continuous media.

^MM.name: Print Mode
^MM.description: Determines the action the printer takes after a label or group of labels has printed (tear-off, peel, rewind, cutter, applicator, etc.).

^MN.name: Media Tracking
^MN.description: Specifies the media type being used and the black mark offset in dots.

^MP.name: Mode Protection
^MP.description: Disables various mode functions on the control panel. Once disabled, the settings for that mode function can no longer be changed and the associated LED does not light.

^MT.name: Media Type
^MT.description: Selects the type of media being used: thermal transfer (ribbon) or direct thermal (no ribbon).

^MU.name: Set Units of Measurement
^MU.description: Sets the units of measurement (dots, inches, mm) and allows DPI conversion for cross-resolution label compatibility.

^MW.name: Modify Head Cold Warning
^MW.description: Sets the head cold warning indicator based on the operating environment. Enables or disables the warning when the printhead temperature is too low.

^NB.name: Network Boot Search
^NB.description: Tells the printer whether to search for a wired print server at bootup.

^NC.name: Select Primary Network Device
^NC.description: Selects the wired or wireless print server as the primary network device.

^ND.name: Change Network Settings
^ND.description: Changes the network settings on supported printers. For external wired settings, same as ^NS. For wireless settings, same as ^WI.

^NI.name: Network ID Number
^NI.description: Assigns a network ID number to the printer for use in a network.

^NN.name: Set SNMP
^NN.description: Sets the Simple Network Management Protocol (SNMP) parameters.

^NP.name: Set Primary Device
^NP.description: Specifies whether to use the printer's or the print server's LAN/WLAN settings at boot time.

^NS.name: Change Wired Networking Settings
^NS.description: Changes the wired print server network settings.

^NT.name: Set SMTP
^NT.description: Sets the Simple Mail Transfer Protocol (SMTP) parameters for e-mail alert settings.

^NW.name: Set Web Authentication Timeout
^NW.description: Sets the timeout value for the printer home page web authentication. The printer prompts for the password after the timeout expires or the printer is reset.

^PA.name: Advanced Text Properties
^PA.description: Configures advanced text layout features including default glyph behavior, bidirectional text layout, character shaping, and OpenType table support.

^PF.name: Slew Given Number of Dot Rows
^PF.description: Causes the printer to slew (move at high speed without printing) a specified number of dot rows from the bottom of the label, allowing faster printing when the bottom portion is blank.

^PH.name: Slew to Home Position
^PH.description: Feeds one blank label to advance the media to the home position.

~PH.name: Slew to Home Position
~PH.description: Feeds one blank label to advance the media to the home position.

^PM.name: Printing Mirror Image of Label
^PM.description: Prints the entire printable area of the label as a mirror image, flipping left to right. Remains active until ^PMN is received or printer is powered off.

^PN.name: Present Now
^PN.description: Causes the printer to run a presenter cycle, ejecting the specified amount of media.

^PO.name: Print Orientation
^PO.description: Set overall print orientation. Inverts the label format 180 degrees when set to I.

^PP.name: Programmable Pause
^PP.description: Places the printer in Pause Mode after the current label is complete. Identical to pressing PAUSE on the control panel.

~PP.name: Programmable Pause
~PP.description: Places the printer in Pause Mode after the current label is complete. Identical to pressing PAUSE on the control panel.

^PQ.name: Print Quantity
^PQ.description: Controls number of labels to print, pause/cut interval between sets, serial number replicates, override pause, and cut-on-error behavior.

^PR.name: Print Rate
^PR.description: Sets print, slew, and backfeed speeds. Setting persists until reissued or printer is powered off.

^PW.name: Print Width
^PW.description: Set printable label width in dots (bounded by profile when provided). Default: last permanently saved value.

^RB.name: Define EPC Data Structure
^RB.description: Defines the structure of EPC data for reading from or writing to an RFID tag, specifying partitions and their bit sizes.

^RF.name: Read or Write RFID Format
^RF.description: Reads or writes (encodes) an RFID tag, or specifies the access password. Data is provided via ^FD command.

^RL.name: RFID Lock/Unlock Tag Memory
^RL.description: Locks or unlocks RFID tag memory. Supports permanent lock of all memory (P), permanent lock of specified sections (B), and reversible lock/unlock of individual memory banks (M).

^RS.name: Set Up RFID Parameters
^RS.description: Sets up RFID parameters including tag type, programming position, retry count, and error handling for RFID label encoding.

^RU.name: Read Unique RFID Chip Serialization
^RU.description: Reads the TID (Tag ID) from the current RFID chip and formats a unique 38-bit serial number placed in the lower bits of the EPC code.

^RW.name: Set RF Power Levels
^RW.description: Sets the RFID read and write power levels and antenna element selection when desired levels are not achieved through RFID tag calibration.

^SC.name: Set Serial Communications
^SC.description: Changes the serial communications parameters. All parameters must be specified or the command is ignored.

^SE.name: Select Encoding Table
^SE.description: Selects the desired ZPL or ZPL II encoding table. Encoding tables are provided with the font card or downloaded in flash with the font.

^SF.name: Serialization Field
^SF.description: Serializes a standard ^FD string using a mask and increment pattern. The mask defines which characters to serialize and the increment defines the value added per label.

^SI.name: Set Sensor Intensity
^SI.description: Changes the values for the media sensors, which are also set during the media calibration process.

^SL.name: Set Mode and Language
^SL.description: Specifies the Real-Time Clock mode of operation and language for printing information. Controls whether the time is captured at format start (S) or at print time (T).

^SN.name: Serialization Data
^SN.description: Allows the printer to index data fields by a selected increment or decrement value. Can be performed on 100-150 fields per format, on both alphanumeric and barcode fields. A maximum of 12 right-most integers are subject to indexing.

^SO.name: Set Offset (for Real-Time Clock)
^SO.description: Sets the secondary or tertiary offset from the primary Real-Time Clock, allowing different date/time values to appear on the same label.

^SP.name: Start Print
^SP.description: Allows a label to start printing at a specified dot row before the entire label has been completely formatted, improving throughput on complex labels.

^SQ.name: Halt ZebraNet Alert
^SQ.description: Stops or starts the ZebraNet Alert option for a specific condition type and destination.

^SR.name: Set Printhead Resistance
^SR.description: Sets the printhead resistance value. The value should match or be less than the resistance rating on the printhead being used.

^SS.name: Set Media Sensors
^SS.description: Changes the values for media, web, ribbon, and label length sensors set during the media calibration process.

^ST.name: Set Date and Time (for Real-Time Clock)
^ST.description: Sets the date and time of the Real-Time Clock.

^SX.name: Set ZebraNet Alert
^SX.description: Configures the ZebraNet Alert System to send notifications for specific printer conditions to designated destinations (serial, parallel, email, TCP/IP, UDP/IP, or SNMP).

^SZ.name: Set ZPL Mode
^SZ.description: Selects the programming language used by the printer, allowing labels formatted in both ZPL and ZPL II to be printed.

^TB.name: Text Block
^TB.description: Prints a text block with defined width and height. Features automatic word-wrap. If text exceeds block height, it is truncated. Supports complex text layout features. Preferred over ^FB.

^TO.name: Transfer Object
^TO.description: Copies an object or group of objects from one storage device to another. Supports wildcards (*) for object names and extensions for batch transfers.

^WA.name: Set Antenna Parameters
^WA.description: Sets the values for the receive and transmit antenna.

^WD.name: Print Directory Label
^WD.description: Prints a label listing bar codes, objects stored in DRAM, or fonts with their names, sizes, and attributes.

^WE.name: Set WEP Mode
^WE.description: Enables Wired Equivalent Privacy (WEP) mode and sets WEP encryption values for wireless security.

^WL.name: Set LEAP Parameters
^WL.description: Enables Cisco LEAP mode and sets LEAP user authentication parameters for wireless radio cards.

^WP.name: Set Wireless Password
^WP.description: Sets the four-digit wireless password (separate from the general printer password).

^WR.name: Set Transmit Rate
^WR.description: Changes the transmission rate and power for 802.11b wireless print servers.

^WS.name: Set Wireless Radio Card Values
^WS.description: Sets wireless radio card values for ESSID, operating mode, preamble, pulse, channel mask, and international mode.

^WX.name: Configure Wireless Securities
^WX.description: Configures wireless security settings. The required parameters depend on the selected security type. Replaces ^WE, ^WL, and other individual security commands.

^XA.name: Start Format
^XA.description: Start a new label format (label open). Must be the first command in a label format. Every label must begin with ^XA and end with ^XZ.

^XB.name: Suppress Backfeed
^XB.description: Suppresses forward feed of media to tear-off position depending on the current printer mode. Eliminates the need for backfeed before the next label, improving throughput.

^XF.name: Recall Format
^XF.description: Recalls a stored format to be merged with variable data. Multiple ^XF commands can appear in one format. When recalling, the calling format must contain ^FN commands to merge data properly.

^XG.name: Recall Graphic
^XG.description: Recalls one or more stored graphic images for printing. An image can be recalled and resized as many times as needed in each format. Uses magnification factors to scale the image.

^XS.name: Set Dynamic Media Calibration
^XS.description: Controls whether dynamic media calibration is performed to compensate for variations in label length, position, transmissivity, and/or reflectance after power-up or head open.

^XZ.name: End Format
^XZ.description: End the current label format (label close). Must be the last command in a label format. Every label must begin with ^XA and end with ^XZ.

^ZZ.name: Printer Sleep
^ZZ.description: Sets the printer to sleep mode or wakes it from sleep mode. Sleep mode reduces power consumption when the printer is idle. The printer can be awakened by sending print data or other commands.

~DB.name: Download Bitmap Font
~DB.description: Downloads a bitmap font to the printer defining native cell size, baseline, space size, and character data. Consists of a ZPL II command defining the font followed by structured data for each character.

~DE.name: Download Encoding
~DE.description: Downloads character encoding translation tables to the printer, essential for printing non-standard or foreign language characters with TrueType fonts. Data is a string of ASCII hexadecimal values.

~DG.name: Download Graphic
~DG.description: Downloads an ASCII hex representation of a graphic image to the printer. The data string defines the image using hex nibbles (each character = 4 dots). Use ~DY for more saving and loading options.

~DN.name: Abort Download Graphic
~DN.description: Aborts Graphics Mode and resumes normal printer operation. Use to clear an active ~DG command after aborting transmission from the host device.

~DS.name: Download Intellifont (Scalable Font)
~DS.description: Downloads a scalable Intellifont to the printer. Font must be converted using ZTools utility. Downloaded scalable fonts are not checked for integrity.

~DT.name: Download Bounded TrueType Font
~DT.description: Downloads a bounded TrueType font (fewer than 256 characters) converted via ZTools. Data is a string of ASCII hexadecimal values where the total count must match the size parameter.

~DU.name: Download Unbounded TrueType Font
~DU.description: Downloads an unbounded TrueType font (more than 256 characters, e.g. Asian fonts) converted via ZTools. The Field Block (^FB) command cannot support these fonts.

~DY.name: Download Objects
~DY.description: Downloads graphic objects or fonts in any supported format. Preferred command to download TrueType fonts (faster than ~DU). Also supports downloading wireless certificate files.

~EG.name: Erase Download Graphics
~EG.description: Erases all downloaded graphic images from the printer. See ^ID for selective deletion of stored objects.

~HB.name: Battery Status
~HB.description: Returns battery status information including head voltage, battery voltage, and battery temperature to the host.

~HD.name: Head Diagnostic
~HD.description: Echoes printer status information including power supply and head temperature diagnostics using the terminal emulator.

~HI.name: Host Identification
~HI.description: Returns printer identification information to the host including model, software version, dots-per-millimeter setting, memory size, and detected options.

~HM.name: Host RAM Status
~HM.description: Returns memory status to the host including total RAM installed, maximum RAM available to the user, and currently available RAM (all in kilobytes).

~HQ.name: Host Query
~HQ.description: Causes the printer to send queried information back to the host. Supports multiple query types for status, hardware, maintenance, and identification data.

~HS.name: Host Status Return
~HS.description: Returns three status strings to the host containing communication settings, printer state flags, and configuration information.

~HU.name: Return ZebraNet Alert Configuration
~HU.description: Returns the table of configured ZebraNet Alert settings to the host, showing condition type, destination, set/clear flags, email address, and port number for each alert.

~JA.name: Cancel All
~JA.description: Cancels all format commands in the buffer and any batches currently printing. The printer stops after the current label finishes. All internal buffers are cleared and the DATA LED turns off.

~JB.name: Reset Optional Memory
~JB.description: Resets battery-powered optional memory (B: card). Must be sent if the battery supplying power to the memory card is replaced. Can also be used to reinitialize the B: memory card (card must not be write protected).

~JC.name: Set Media Sensor Calibration
~JC.description: Forces a label length measurement and adjusts media and ribbon sensor values. In Continuous Mode, only the media and ribbon sensors are calibrated. Ignored on HC100 printers.

~JD.name: Enable Communications Diagnostics
~JD.description: Initiates Diagnostic Mode, producing an ASCII printout of all characters received by the printer including ASCII characters, hexadecimal values, and any communication errors.

~JE.name: Disable Diagnostics
~JE.description: Cancels Diagnostic Mode and returns the printer to normal label printing.

~JF.name: Set Battery Condition
~JF.description: Controls printer behavior when battery voltage drops below critical levels on PA/PT400 printers. When enabled, printing pauses at low voltage; when disabled, printing continues with risk of data loss.

~JG.name: Graphing Sensor Calibration
~JG.description: Prints a graph (media sensor profile) of the sensor values. On HC100 printers, prints a sensor profile label without performing calibration.

~JI.name: Start ZBI (Zebra BASIC Interpreter)
~JI.description: Initializes the Zebra BASIC Interpreter (ZBI) in interactive mode. Echoes received characters back to source. Only one ZBI interpreter can be active at a time. Deactivate with ZPL at the ZBI prompt or ~JQ.

~JL.name: Set Label Length
~JL.description: Sets the label length. Depending on the size of the label, the printer feeds one or more blank labels.

~JN.name: Head Test Fatal
~JN.description: Turns on the head test option in fatal mode. Printer halts when a head test failure is encountered and remains in error mode until ~JO is sent or power is cycled.

~JO.name: Head Test Non-Fatal
~JO.description: Configures the printer to run the head test with non-fatal error reporting. An error is displayed and printing stops on failure, but user can press PAUSE to bypass. This is the default head test condition.

~JP.name: Pause and Cancel Format
~JP.description: Clears the format currently being processed and places the printer into Pause Mode. Each subsequent ~JP clears the next buffered format until the buffer is empty. Identical to using CANCEL on the printer.

~JQ.name: Terminate Zebra BASIC Interpreter
~JQ.description: Terminates an active ZBI (Zebra BASIC Interpreter) session. Entering ZPL at the command prompt also terminates a ZBI session.

~JR.name: Power On Reset
~JR.description: Resets all internal software, performs a power-on self-test (POST), clears the buffer and DRAM, and resets communication parameters and default values. Same as a manual power-on reset.

~JS.name: Change Backfeed Sequence
~JS.description: Controls the backfeed sequence for printers with or without cutters. Allows programming the rest point of continuous media cut edge or immediate backfeed after peel-off. Stays in effect until power off or new ~JS command.

~JX.name: Cancel Current Partially Input Format
~JX.description: Cancels a format currently being sent to the printer. Does not affect formats currently printing or subsequent formats.

~KB.name: Kill Battery (Battery Discharge Mode)
~KB.description: Places the printer in battery discharge mode, allowing the battery to be fully drained without printing. Used to maintain rechargeable battery performance in portable printers.

~NC.name: Network Connect
~NC.description: Connects to a particular printer on the network by calling up the printer's network ID number.

~NR.name: Set All Network Printers Transparent
~NR.description: Sets all printers in the network to be transparent, regardless of ID or current mode. Used only with RS-485 printer communications.

~NT.name: Set Currently Connected Printer Transparent
~NT.description: Sets the currently connected network printer to be transparent. With Z Series printers, functions the same as ~NR. Used only with RS-485 printer communications.

~PL.name: Present Length Addition
~PL.description: Sets additional media eject length added to the standard 50 mm clearance during a presenter cycle.

~PM.name: Decommissioning Mode
~PM.description: Places the printer into Decommissioning Mode, clearing configuration and optionally wiping flash memory for secure disposal or transfer.

~PR.name: Applicator Reprint
~PR.description: Reprints the last label printed, similar to the applicator asserting the Reprint signal on the applicator port.

~PS.name: Print Start
~PS.description: Causes a printer in Pause Mode to resume printing. Identical to pressing PAUSE on the control panel when the printer is already paused.

~RO.name: Reset Advanced Counters
~RO.description: Resets the advanced counters used by the printer to monitor label generation in inches, centimeters, and number of labels.

~SD.name: Set Darkness
~SD.description: Sets the darkness of printing. Equivalent to the darkness setting parameter on the control panel display.

~TA.name: Tear-off Adjust Position
~TA.description: Adjusts the rest position of the media after a label is printed, changing the position at which the label is torn or cut.

~WC.name: Print Configuration Label
~WC.description: Generates a printer configuration label containing sensor type, network ID, ZPL mode, firmware version, and descriptive data on R:, E:, B:, and A: devices. Works only when the printer is idle.

~WL.name: Print Network Configuration Label
~WL.description: Generates and prints a network configuration label showing wireless and wired network settings.

~WQ.name: Write Query
~WQ.description: Triggers the printer to print a label with odometer, maintenance/alert, and printhead history information based on the query type.

~WR.name: Reset Wireless Radio Card
~WR.description: Reinitializes the wireless radio card and the print server (wired or wireless), causing any wireless radio card to reassociate to the wireless network.
